paragraphs.text: Withengar is a powerful demon from the plane of Innistrad . He is infamous for slaying Saint Traft .

Before the events of Innistrad block , the Skirsdag cultists led a monster slayer named Saint Traft into a trap. They blinded him and switched the sword in his hand for Elbrus , the Binding Blade. Traft slew the cultists with this weapon, inadvertently summoning Withengar in the process, a dreadful demon whose essence was bound in the bone sword. Withengar ended the life of Traft while laughing.
paragraphs.section: The saint, the geist, and the angel

paragraphs.text: His victory did not last long, since Innistrad's angels vengefully attacked him and destroyed his physical body. However, Withengar did not die but reverted to pure black mana . Without being attached to the sword or any restrictive spell, it would only be a matter of time for the demon to reincarnate and feast yet again upon the devastation of the plane.
paragraphs.section: The saint, the geist, and the angel

paragraphs.text: Withengar was reincarnated during the events of Dark Ascension , which were caused by the absence of Avacyn .
